_readme: Packaged-EA suite definitions, shared by the EA Portfolio Engine and MT5Tools.
A suite = one packaged-EA configuration (product x risk level), with 'members' =
the matching main-pool strategies and 'package_ea' = the standalone packaged
backtest inside the packaged_suites timeline.
FRAMEWORK (confirmed Aug 2026 from trade comments in the packaged backtests):
TradeFrequency selects HOW MANY internal strategies run - higher levels ADD
lower-timeframe strategies for more frequency. Gold Reaper: ExtremeConservative
= strategies 1-3 (Daily), Conservative = 1-5 (+H4/H1), Moderate = 1-7,
Intense = 1-8. Gold Phantom: ExtremeConservative = 1-3, Conservative =
1,2,3,4,6, Moderate = 1-7 (UBS public sets cover only 3 variants - the other
Phantom UBS sets were never released publicly). GoldBotOne and GoldTradePro
always run all 8. Package-internal numbering matches the UBS one-chart set
numbering (The Gold Reaper_XAUUSD_N == GoldReaper_strategyN).
CALIBRATION (the min-lot 0.01 -> lot-step check): realized max DD at stepped
lots came in AT or UNDER the 5% design target everywhere - Gold Reaper
3.1-4.3% balance DD (ExtremeConservative equity DD 6.6%, the only marginal
overshoot), Gold Phantom 1.5-1.9%, GoldBotOne 2.1%, GoldTradePro 0.9%.
Grouped-off-main vs package: per-risk-unit P&L nearly identical for
ExtremeConservative; daily corr 0.80-0.90 overall (package weights internal
strategies differently than equal risk units) - grouping is a fair
directional stand-in, package-level questions use the packaged_suites
timeline directly.
